verdict.rationale: The sign-in and identity-verification axis applies to Companies House, and the evidence confirms an identity-verification service exists. Nothing in the pack describes the method: no credential MFA, no remote-completable flow, and nothing ruling out biometric liveness, in-person checks or a PIN sent by post. The registered-API-key auth challenge covers read access to the API, not the founder sign-in path, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
